title: Gift shop closed/open for the season

steps.name: Open closed-for-season op
steps.do: Select **Set gift shop as closed for the season**.
steps.expect: The form opens with **Gift Shop**, **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason**.

steps.name: Submit with blank reason
steps.do: Select **Zootique**. Leave **Start date**, **Last day** and **Reason** blank. Click **Save**.
steps.expect: Success that **Zootique** was set as closed for the season.

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Gift Shops**. Leave **Include closed gift shops** unchecked.

steps.name: Season message
steps.do: Enable **Include closed gift shops** and click **Zootique**.
steps.expect: **Zootique** appears with a light winter-blue background. The popup is blue with a snowflake, the same as an animal off display for the season, and reads **The Zootique is closed for the season.**

steps.name: Open-for-season lists season only
steps.do: In Console, open **Set gift shop as open for the season** and expand **Gift Shop**.
steps.expect: **Zootique** is listed. The form has no start date or last day. A gift shop that is only temporarily closed is not listed.

steps.name: Submit open for season
steps.expect: Success that **Zootique** was set as open for the season.

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Gift Shops** enabled and **Include closed gift shops** unchecked.
steps.expect: **Zootique** shows as a normal open gift shop again.
